title: Line sketch: Abstract and Layers
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: layers in earthy tones with leaf accents create a textured abstract composition. Metallic diamonds and dripping elements add luxurious detail to the flowing horizontal bands (derived from painting #807).
